vd-completion-handoff.title: Virtual Display completion handoff
vd-completion-handoff.description: Keep VD task completion in ClosePaw chat by default and expose a single explicit Open <App> CTA for the last valid real app. New Session remains a pure chat reset and must not trigger app/viewer handoff. The originally designed View virtual screen CTA was implemented during the branch and removed before merge; restoring it belongs to vd-runtime-boundary once VD lifetime/controls are fixed.
acceptCriteria: projects/archive/20260516_vd_completion_handoff/implementation_summary.md exists and records shipped PR #40
projects/archive/20260516_vd_completion_handoff/qa_report.md exists with shipped behavior notes
All vd-completion-handoff child tasks are terminal
No automatic app/viewer handoff happens on TaskCompleted or New Session
vd-completion-handoff.note: Archived after shipped implementation narrowed the handoff surface to a single Open <App> CTA; viewer CTA deferred to vd-runtime-boundary.

vd-handoff-event-model.title: VD handoff event and chat model
vd-handoff-event-model.description: Add optional CompletionHandoff metadata to task completion and completed chat rows so VD completions can carry the last valid real app package/label. Final shipped model deliberately omits viewer availability after the viewer CTA was removed.

vd-handoff-capture.title: Capture VD completion handoff metadata
vd-handoff-capture.description: Build handoff metadata when emitting TaskCompleted in VD mode: capture the last foreground app package/label after filtering self, SystemUI, and BLOCKED-tier packages. Accessibility mode emits no handoff.
acceptCriteria: VD TaskCompleted emits handoff metadata with package/label when a valid VD foreground package is active

vd-handoff-render.title: Render explicit VD handoff CTAs
vd-handoff-render.description: Render the shipped completion-row CTA for valid VD handoff metadata and route taps explicitly: Open <App> launches the app on the real display. The View virtual screen CTA is intentionally absent until vd-runtime-boundary makes a retained viewer usable.
acceptCriteria: Completed VD rows show Open <App> only when PackageManager can resolve a launcher intent and the package is allowed
Completed VD rows do not show View virtual screen in the shipped implementation
TaskCompleted itself does not start any activity; only CTA callbacks launch an app

new-session-no-handoff-regression.title: New Session does not trigger VD handoff
new-session-no-handoff-regression.description: Regression coverage and routing/lifecycle behavior ensure tapping New Session never opens the last VD app or the VD viewer. Handoff remains available only through explicit completion CTAs on existing completed rows.
acceptCriteria: A regression or QA pass covers New Session after a completed VD task and observes no app/viewer handoff
